name: Lusha
description: Lusha lets agents search and enrich contacts and companies with B2B data from the signed-in Lusha account. Enrichment uses the account's Lusha credits.

prompts.text: Find the size, industry, and location of the company Acme Robotics.
Find heads of marketing at software companies in Berlin with 50 to 200 employees.
Enrich this list of five contacts with job titles and companies.

apps.name: Lusha
apps.description: Contact and company search and enrichment, over Lusha's MCP server with browser sign-in.
